title: Mediterranean Veggie Chickpea Bake with Feta, Tzatziki & Pita

steps.text: Drain and rinse chickpeas. Transfer to a large baking sheet pan.
Wash, dry, trim, and seed bell peppers; slice lengthwise into ½-inch thick strips. Add to the baking sheet with the chickpeas.
Wash and dry tomatoes. Add to the baking sheet.
Peel, halve, and thinly slice onions lengthwise. Add to the baking sheet, drizzle with vinaigrette, and season with spices. Toss to combine and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, tossing once, until veggies are tender and tomatoes start to burst, 20-25 minutes.
Meanwhile, arrange pitas on another baking sheet. Add to the oven and bake, flipping halfway through, until slightly crispy, about 5 minutes. Remove from oven, cut into wedges, and set aside.
When the chickpeas and veggies are done, remove from oven. Sprinkle with feta and toss to combine.
Divide chickpea and veggie bake between plates or bowls. Serve with pita wedges and tzatziki on the side. Enjoy!
